title: Form 1099-DIV box 1b statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every qualified dividend amount reported in box 1b of a Form 1099-DIV furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item. This claim covers Form 1099-DIV box 1b only: it says nothing about box 1a, the recorded non-composable boxes (2a, 3, 5, 7, 12), dividends not reported on Form 1099-DIV, or qualified dividends in total (Form 1040 line 3a). This family closes independently of the box-1a family; its line may block while the other publishes.
